entry.content:
Terminology

Walks →（start = end）→ Closed Walks →（除起点终点外，节点互异）→ Cycles

Paths：no node repetition
（Walks：allow node repetition）

directed →；undirected —

Degrees：degree = in-degree + out-degree

Connectivity：

  • for two nodes：there is a path from iii to jjj（ignore directions）
  • for graph：∀ i,j\forall\, i, j∀i,j connected
  • Strong connectivity for graph：∀\forall∀ node ∃\exists∃ a directed path to every other node

Subgraph：

  • for G=(N,A)G = (N, A)G=(N,A):
  • subgraph G′=(N′,A′)G' = (N', A')G′=(N′,A′)：N′⊆NN' \subseteq NN′⊆N，A′⊆AA' \subseteq AA′⊆A
  • spanning subgraph G′=(N′,A′)G' = (N', A')G′=(N′,A′)：N′=NN' = NN′=N，A′⊆AA' \subseteq AA′⊆A

CC(connected component)：a maximal connected subgraph

SCC(strongly CC)：a maximal strongly connected subgraph

Acyclic graph：A directed graph without directed cycle.

tree：A connected graph without cycle.

  • properties：

    • ① nnn nodes →\rightarrow→ n−1n-1n−1 arcs（proof. induction, use property② or Lec2_notes Lemma）
    • ② 若 nodes ≥2\geq 2≥2 则 leaves ≥2\geq 2≥2（leaf：d=1d=1d=1 的 node）
    • ③ 任意两个 nodes 被唯一 path 连接

  • subtree：A connected subgraph of a tree.

forest：A graph without cycle.

  • & tree：not necessarily connected
  • & acyclic graphs：without any cycle（even the undirected cycle）

rooted trees：root predecessor successor 相对于 root 的方向

Spanning tree：spanning graph →tree\xrightarrow{\text{tree}}tree​ spanning tree

bipartite graph：G=(N,A)G = (N, A)G=(N,A)，N=N1+N2N = N_1 + N_2N=N1​+N2​，∀arc(i,j)∈A\forall \text{arc}(i,j) \in A∀arc(i,j)∈A：

[(i∈N1)∧(j∈N2)]  ∨  [(i∈N2)∧(j∈N1)][(i \in N_1) \wedge (j \in N_2)] \;\vee\; [(i \in N_2) \wedge (j \in N_1)][(i∈N1​)∧(j∈N2​)]∨[(i∈N2​)∧(j∈N1​)]

property：A graph is bipartite ⟺\Longleftrightarrow⟺ every cycle has even length.

proof. 见 Lec2 notes Theorem 1。

Euler’s Circuit Theorem

（Seven bridges of Königsberg）

Eulerian Circuit：a closed walk cover all arcs.

Euler's Circuit Theorem

An undirected connected graph has an Eulerian circuit ⟺\Longleftrightarrow⟺ the degree of every node is even.

proof.

  • necessity：边的全覆盖 →\rightarrow→ 点的全覆盖；每个点：有进必有出 ⇒\Rightarrow⇒ 度为偶数。
  • sufficiency：
    • Lemma：undirected connected graph，every node’s degree is even ⇒\Rightarrow⇒ it contains a closed walk ⇒\Rightarrow⇒ it contains a cycle.
    • Induction：
      • GGG：undirected connected graph，∀\forall∀ nodes even degree
      • base：GGG with 2 edges has an Eulerian circuit
      • hypothesis：GGG with fewer than mmm edges has an Eulerian circuit
      • induction step：GGG with mmm edges
        1. 用 Lemma 找出一条 cycle CCC；
        2. G−C=G′G - C = G'G−C=G′；
        3. 对 G′G'G′ 的每个 component 用 hypothesis，可以得到不同的 Eulerian circuit；
        4. 把这些 Eulerian circuits 链接到 CCC；
        5. 形成一条 closed walk 就得到一个 Eulerian circuit。

Graph/Network representations

1. Adjacency matrix（邻接矩阵）

  • 行和 = 出度：(H1n)i=dout(i)(\mathcal{H} \mathbf{1}_n)_i = d_{\text{out}}(i)(H1n​)i​=dout​(i)
  • 列和 = 入度：(1n⊤H)i=din(i)(\mathbf{1}_n^\top \mathcal{H})_i = d_{\text{in}}(i)(1n⊤​H)i​=din​(i)
Number of walks and powers of adjacency matrix

Let H\mathcal{H}H be an adjacency matrix of a directed graph GGG. Then (Hk)ij(\mathcal{H}^k)_{ij}(Hk)ij​ equals the number of directed walks of length kkk from node iii to node jjj.

proved by induction，Lec2 notes Theorem 2。

(1) Rank of incidence matrix

Rank of incidence matrix

Let B∈Rn×mB \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times m}B∈Rn×m be an incidence matrix of a connected directed graph GGG. Then rank⁡(B)=n−1\operatorname{rank}(B) = n - 1rank(B)=n−1.

Lec2 notes Theorem 3。

Network Transformation

minimum cost flow standard：i→(cij, 0, uij)ji \xrightarrow{(c_{ij},\,0,\,u_{ij})} ji(cij​,0,uij​)​j。

① 有下界：preflow 将下界置零

② 代价为负：改变边方向，代价调正

③ 无向边：化成有向边，用定理约束

Property of the optimal solution to the naive formulation

If cij≥0c_{ij} \geq 0cij​≥0, then there exists an optimal solution in which at least one of fijf_{ij}fij​ and fjif_{ji}fji​ is zero.
